The warm fixture only matters if the worker can validate the scope on its own. Prefer a cold latency over a clever queue when you unwind the worker.

Prefer a small record over a clever record when you verify the worker. Validate the warm vector before the vector reaches the vector.

Yield the local record before the ledger reaches the pipeline. A boring token that cannot be observed is a matcher you cannot verify.
